<Activity x:Class="AnchorBase" xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/netfx/2009/xaml/activities" xmlns:ui="http://schemas.uipath.com/workflow/activities" xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml">
  <ui:AnchorBase AnchorProvider="{x:Null}" AnchorPosition="Auto">
    <ui:AnchorBase.Action>
      <ActivityAction x:TypeArguments="ui:Anchor">
        <ActivityAction.Argument>
          <DelegateInArgument x:TypeArguments="ui:Anchor" Name="ContextAnchor" />
        </ActivityAction.Argument>
      </ActivityAction>
    </ui:AnchorBase.Action>
  </ui:AnchorBase>
</Activity>
